metadata.name: Basement Scrapbook Menu
metadata.description:
[h1]Basement Scrapbook Menu[/h1] The whole main menu of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ redrawn as a hand-made scrapbook pinned to the basement wall: torn paper, pins, tape, blood stains, pencil doodles and handwritten notes.
[h2]What's inside[/h2] [list] [*][b]Title, save files, main menu[/b] — paper sheets with the game's progress drawings; the picked sheet lifts and shakes. [*][b]Character select[/b] — a list on the left and a big card: portrait, health, stats, starting items, notes, completion marks. Normal, tainted and tarnished (Epiphany) versions. Characters from mods (Fiend Folio, Furtherance, IPECAC, Lost and Forgotten…) get their own tabs automatically. [*][b]Every other screen[/b] — challenges and modded challenges, special seeds, stats, collection as a sticker album, bestiary, endings, secrets (achievements with how to unlock them), options, controls. [*][b]Mods screen as a blueprint[/b] — every installed mod is a tile with its Workshop picture: colour = enabled, black and white = disabled. Only mods you actually have are shown. [*][b]Pause screen[/b] — a reminder of the hotkeys of the mods you have installed. [*]Arrow keys move exactly the way each screen is drawn (grids by rows and columns, lists up and down). [*]English or Russian — follows the game language. [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3127536138]REPENTOGON[/url] [/list] Works with any set of mods: whatever belongs to a mod you don't have is simply not shown.
[h2]Compatibility[/h2] Other mods that replace the main menu graphics may look odd together with this one. Gameplay is not touched.
[h2]Links[/h2] Source code: [url=https://github.com/blackhellvelz-prog/isaac-basement-scrapbook-menu]GitHub[/url] More from the same set: Dead Sea Scrolls: Unrolled, Talents for Everyone, Peat, Isaac-Style, Mod Fixes & Speedups, Russian Translation for Mods.
Pictures of popular mods are used in the Mods menu and the DSS window — thanks to their creators and the Isaac modding community!
Made with Universal Modder. Menu art generated with Meshy AI. Author: blackhellvelz.
